scope: Independent read review of root-owned callback, reset, consent and transient UI integration
verdict: No P1 or P2 findings within the inspected scope
observations: Observation start binds an opaque ticket after cancellation and before fetch; the result callback receives that same ticket.
The original response validator remains unchanged; request-version checks also run after the awaited result callback.
Learning mutation, consent, episode reset, capture cancellation and page disposal clear transient observation state.
The expiry timer is bounded by accepted capture expiry and canceled on clear/reset/dispose.
App supplies the original session snapshot and policy to the learning bridge; no new identity or consent authority is introduced.
Transient UI labels source and advisory context and preserves the quiet preference until explicit ask.
limitations: Scoped code review only; no claim of production host, physical glasses, camera identity or hosted provider qualification.
Browser qualification is separately recorded in observation-browser-report.json.
